description: The isolated early-reflex checkpoint produced Task-target entries after actor intervention on both exact impact directions and improved degraded-left self-righting to 7.30 seconds, but only 12 actor steps made degraded-right unrecoverable. The 14-DOF residual was allowed to perturb sagittal hip/knee torques and waist pitch even though its trigger is a lateral momentum excursion. Preserve the same continuous Mission, timing gate, causal replay, bilateral contract, reward, and budget, but restrict learned authority to the four leg abduction motors and waist roll; the Program retains every sagittal and pitch action.
